Type: tall solid wood bookcase
Use: storing books, displaying decor and collections; living room, home office, study, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: solid pine with a black-brown stain, visible wood grain
Colors: dark black-brown, espresso
Shape: tall upright frame on four short square legs, framed side panels, overhanging flat top, several open adjustable shelves, straight edges, substantial and dark
Feel: solid, cozy, studious, timeless
Goes with: cream or white walls, warm textiles, brass accents, dark wood; traditional studies, farmhouse or classic living rooms
